# DUCK SHOOT - C. Fethers - DREAMER 11 p.21 (PDF page 23) - CHIP-8 0200-03EB (printed range 0200-0400)
# run C000 (FN 3). A duck flies around the screen, bouncing off the edges; move the gun sight and fire.
# 20 rounds; after each shot the rounds left are shown briefly; a hit duck dies and the rounds and
# dead ducks are shown. When the ammunition is exhausted the total 'bag' is shown.
# keys: 8 left, A right, 5 up, 1 down, F fire (key codes at 02D1, 02D7, 02DD, 02E3 and 0235).
# The scanned copy carries a reader's handwritten changes, NOT applied here: keys remapped
# (02D1 04, 02D7 06, 02DD 09?, 02E3 01), duck sprite bytes 02F0/02F5 -> 67, 0296 1296 -> 1080 and an
# added row "0080 F00A 300F 1080 00E0 1200" (restart on key 0).  Printed values are kept.
